title: Bonus Nintendo Switch 2 Console with Purchase of Google Pixel 11 Pro $1849 / 11 Pro XL $2099 ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ JB Hi-FI
body:
Deal: Bonus Nintendo Switch 2 Console with Purchase of Google Pixel 11 Pro $1849 / 11 Pro XL $2099 ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ JB Hi-FI

[Jty05] Quite tempting - been in the market for a new phone for a few months now and have always wanted a Switch 2
Does anyone know how the Pixel performs when gaming? I play a Unity based MOBA quite often and wanted to know how it did
[Kazusa] Pixel performs very bad compared to its competition, a similarly priced snapdragon/mediatek would smoke this in performance + efficiency in gaming
[Pluto88] True I have the 8 pro and it was quite behind even when launched, considering not for the performance but for the additional years of updates even with the same amount of ram that's where the pixel shines I think.
[Rogue01] From GSMArena:
Google's Tensor chips have never been benchmark chart-toppers, and the Tensor G6 is no different. Sure, it delivers the promised CPU and AI boost, but the CPU is quick to throttle down under sustained load and the graphics chip is far from the competition in its capabilities.
https://m.gsmarena.com/google_pixel_11_pro_xl-review-2994p6.…
It's got a small battery, a sub optimal CPU/GPU, and throttles quickly.
This is not the (gaming) phone you are looking for.
[xrailgun] this is one of the strangest promos I've ever seen
[TheDukeOfNukem] To be fair, you always used to get game consoles thrown in with phone plans. In the day, every other week you'd see Crazy John's trying to flog some phone with an Xbox or PS2.
[sydney rider] how the receipt/tax invoice actually looks?
Does JB list the phone at full price and the device as $0 / "bonus", or do they split the discount across both items on separate line items?
Looking to see how the invoice breakdown displays on C&C. Thanks!
[dimple] Interested also
I’m thinking TRS but I don’t want to take the switch with me
[Secret ID] I just tried to add the phone in the cart. The phone was full price and it automatically added the Switch at $0.
You can try too.
[jtrvk] When a phone can't game, bundle a freaking console with it
[zagadka] Pretty great deal for anyone who doesn’t own a phone already
But people who already own phones will just stick with their iPhones
[GreenWave] Will this offer apply if you try to price match the phone with another store/website?
[Duece1995] I'm not sure how this is even a deal. You could've bought a Pixel 11 pro XL for $1158 using with bonus $2000 gift card promotion. https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/979272
[PainToad] Since Switch 2 recomps are already starting to happen, one day the phone might play Switch 2 games natively.
[GoldAlwaysGold] Bonus DJI Neo 2 would be more enticing, but at this price I'd rather get a fold phone
[Fredfloresjr] How to dispose something you cannot sell
[Larz24] Struggling to see how this is a deal as a true Ozb bin rat.
You are being lured with a free switch 2 at RRP and still ponying up for the Pixel 11 Pro/XL, which after considering the freebie still isn’t that cheap.. add to that you are left with a device that lets be honest isn’t worth the asking/discounted price to start with.
You can flip the Switch2 and be left with a questionable phone choice or attempt to flip the P11 (which I assume is much more difficult) to get a discounted Switch2.
